item.title: MonkKit — 106 Free Developer Tools in One Place
item.description: I was tired of bouncing between a dozen different sites just to format JSON or decode a JWT. One tab for a JSON formatter. Another for a Base64 decoder. Another for a DNS lookup. Another for an SPF validator. Browser full of bookmarks, half of them plastered with ads, most requiring an account to do anything useful. So I built MonkKit — a single place for all of them. 106 free developer tools across 10 categories.

item.title: HashiCorp Certified Terraform Associate
item.description: Finally, HashiCorp has announced the general availability of some of their Cloud Certifications like Terraform and Vault (and others to come like Consul).The exam is taken online with a live proctor. Its a mix of multiple-choices and “fill in the blanks” test with 57 questions for 1 hour. Terraform associate is a foundational level of certification that evaluates your understanding of basic concepts and skills on Terraform OSS and the features exist on Terraform Cloud & Terraform Enterprise packages.
